notes: Zero-length shifts and classes now warn you instead of failing silently: a shift typed 9:00 AM – 9:00 AM shows a warning on the shift row and in the Paycheck tab's detections box, and a class typed that way is flagged in the week view and both exports. It still pays 0 hrs (fixed in 2.44.0) — now you'll see the typo. A zero-length entry also no longer flags as overlapping a real class or shift that contains it.
